invest.quote: 2700 Prototype $2,708,932 $4,240,095 ... This includes Initial Fees (as set forth in Item 5) of $68,500 to $162,000 per restaurant opened under a Single Store Development Agreement

fee.quote: If you enter into a Franchise Agreement, you must construct and equip the Restaurant, acquire and convert an existing building or acquire an existing IHOP Restaurant, and pay an Initial Franchise Fee of $50,000.
fee.note: A $15,000 Location Fee (Single Store Development Agreement) is applied to the $50,000 fee. Dual Branded Restaurant: $35,000. Multi-Store Development: $20,000 Development Fee per Restaurant plus $40,000 Initial Franchise Fee per Restaurant (Development Fee credited). Purchase Program (taking over an existing Restaurant): $0 to $300,000. Opening Training Support Fee $0 to $65,000 and POS setup $3,500 to $9,000 also paid to IHOP. Fees non-refundable; IHOP may reduce or waive them.

royalty.quote: Royalty 4.5% of total Gross Sales 2 Billed weekly and due 16 days after invoice date

special: Real estate is not included in the Single Store estimates. Under the Purchase Program the franchisee typically subleases the land and building from an IHOP Affiliate and leases equipment from IHOP; the FDD states it is the custom of IHOP Affiliates 'to charge rentals which exceed both the base rent and the percentage rent payable by the applicable IHOP Affiliate to the Master Landlord'. Non-traditional venues (51 franchised in 2025) are offered under a separate FDD.
